annotation.interpretation_a: Endpoints are encouraged, but not required, to include buffering delays.
annotation.interpretation_b: Endpoints are expected to include buffering delays, but may omit them under certain circumstances.
annotation.justification: The use of 'SHOULD' creates ambiguity. It's unclear whether endpoints are expected to include buffering delays as a best practice, or whether they are permitted to omit them. This affects implementation, as some may choose to always include them, while others may only do so conditionally.
annotation.missing_information: The degree to which 'SHOULD' implies expectation versus permission is unclear. A precise definition of when buffering delays *should* be included, or a clarification of the intent of 'SHOULD' in this context, would resolve the ambiguity.
